grammar.numbers: flash card: the number slams in with a small camera shake and a striped one-bar meter (percent on a 10 % scale, else full); a date said as a stat is a tear-off calendar page under the reel's own label
grammar.comparisons: two flash columns cut by a diagonal hazard slash with a VS disc; values slam in; tone colour only for good/bad rows; the question as a gold strip
grammar.steps: numbered bulletins slam in from the right top-down as each is said; unsaid slots are dim striped placeholders; the current one lit
grammar.change: old value big, a gold strike line draws across it, it shrinks up; the new value SLAMS in huge with a shockwave ring, a camera shake and an arrow only when the cue gives a direction; a difference chip only when both values parse with the same unit
grammar.trend: alert line that draws itself in gold, each point pops with its value printed, the last one pulses; no up/down colour
grammar.banks: flash card with the logo on white, neutral label; a bank named while the stage is busy rides as a small chip
grammar.captionPosition: fixed navy news strip under the stage, left-aligned, keywords gold, the word being said underlined in gold; English line under it

skinAxes.cover: logo tile on white, the gold alert bar slammed in, title punched in with a shake, a hazard tape across the bottom
skinAxes.captions: bold white on a navy strip with a gold top rule and a running hazard edge
skinAxes.framing: pure motion graphics, no footage: deep navy with a pulsing gold siren glow and a drifting diagonal texture
skinAxes.transitions: punch-ins with camera shake, slams, a diagonal hazard band sweeping through on every beat
skinAxes.texture: gold/navy hazard stripes, light-sweep glints over headlines, shockwave rings
skinAxes.sound: voice + whip on the change slam, clicks on bulletins and compare cards
skinAxes.cta: white contact card + compliance card (classic outro)
